scope: Current independent runner plus private renderer reuse, classic uncapped frame scheduling and lazy VAAPI discovery, compared against stock Playwright on all six original controlled scenario families. No product or original test-body edits.

policy.scope: Extend current separate-browser native composition to all six unchanged controlled scenario families before final matrix work. Functional preflight followed by two reversed-order matched blocks. No product edits or test-body changes.

policy.decision: Locate which declared scenario families meet an observed 2x in both worker counts and reversed blocks; failures stay visible and prevent that family from qualifying. No change to final 9 scenario / 8 pair confidence gate or minimum two real application wins.
limitations: Engineering screen, not final resource or performance admission.
Intentional failure 250ms waits and worker replacement remain unchanged.

failedAttempts.secondFailure: Version extraction chose the stock alternative in the driver admission list. Select the unique custom alternative and verify it against the retained actual browser identity before rerunning.

diagnosticPhases.scope: Two separate sequential library runs, 15 fresh contexts each; an extra repeated assertion is explicitly added. Intervals include scheduling and all work below each API call. sourceFindings: The first locator assertion creates an isolated world, evaluates a combined 373154-byte runtime, then calls its resident assertion.
Every fresh document rebuilds and sends the full runtime; subsequent same-document assertions reuse it.
Renderer transfer performs serial inventory, hold, page drain, prepare, detach, allocation and adoption operations. Context-close timing includes this work; it does not isolate GC.
